videos.video_subject: Mbappé scored in Real Madrid's 4-3 comeback at Roma in his 100th Champions League game, the youngest ever to 100 appearances, ahead of Messi, still without a Champions League title
videos.video_script: Real Madrid were losing three-one in Rome. Mbappé was playing his hundredth Champions League game. He scored his seventy-second goal in the competition, and Madrid came back to win four-three. At twenty-seven, he is the youngest player ever to reach one hundred appearances. Even Messi was slower. But Mbappé still has no Champions League trophy. Is this his year?
